EM1019 - Elasticitat i Resistència de Materials

learning_outcomes.text: To be able to solve materials engineering problems through experimentation by working in a team.
To be able to solve materials engineering problems.
To be able to analyze the behavior of materials in welding and adhesive bonding processes.
To be able to explain the causes of in-service material failure, the causes of wear, and corrosion protection techniques.
To be able to select coating techniques or modifications of material properties.
To be able to propose inspection techniques using non-destructive testing and apply regulations related to materials engineering.

syllabus_topics: Block III: Surface modification of materials
teaching_methods: Lectures (magistral, receptive, dialectical, discovery learning, questions/problems, cooperative work, active participation)
Problem classes (magistral, collaborative problem-solving, discovery learning - autonomous or cooperative)
Laboratory practical classes (magistral lecture for introduction, flipped classroom for introduction, tutorial method for practice development)
Use of slides, real materials, simple experiments, videos, and Moodle virtual environment.
assessment_rules: To pass the subject, a minimum of 5 out of 10 points must be obtained in the overall grade. For the first call, the overall grade is a weighted average of Continuous Assessment (40% - Lab practices 30%, Evaluable activities 10%) and a Final Exam (60%), with a minimum score of 4 out of 10 required for the Final Exam. For the second call, continuous assessment accounts for 30% (laboratory practices are not recoverable and use the first call grade) and the final exam accounts for 70%, also requiring a minimum of 4 out of 10. If the minimum score on the final exam is not achieved in either the first or second call, the overall grade cannot exceed 4.5 out of 10. Laboratory practices are not recoverable due to logistical limitations.
